title: UOL buys out UOB stake in former Faber House for S$68.5 million
asset_name: Former Faber House / Nomad Hotel redevelopment
stake_description: Remaining legal and beneficial title and interest in the property and banking hall.

title: SingLand buys out UOB's stake in Novena Square JVs for S$299 million
stake_description: UOB held 20% stakes in each of Novena Square Development and Novena Square Investments; a related strata lot was acquired for S$19.5 million.
summary: SingLand bought UOB's shares in two Novena Square JV entities for S$299 million and a UOB banking hall strata lot was acquired for S$19.5 million.

title: UI Boustead REIT and Boustead unit co-invest in S$104 million Seletar aerospace facility
buyer: UI Boustead REIT and Boustead Singapore subsidiary
stake_description: UI Boustead REIT holds 51%; Boustead Singapore subsidiary holds the remaining 49%.
summary: The build-to-suit aerospace facility is valued at about S$104 million, with projected GFA of about 252,100 sq ft and a JTC land lease running until 2050.
